handoffPurpose: Record the large-field and skill-menu performance optimization performed on the Windows desktop clone.
currentUserGoal: Read the latest handoff, then optimize the game again because bigger fields tank performance and the skills menu feels very slow.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Avoided full board layouts for ordinary dirty batch-tile churn.
details: Added staleCommonTileKeys to track batch tiles whose common render-texture stamp is stale.
Changed the commonTileLayerDirty path to first queue stale tile redraws through the existing budgeted common redraw queue instead of immediately requesting layoutTiles("dirty").
Kept temporary live dirty tile views capped by the existing dirtyTileViewKeys limit while still tracking over-limit stale tiles for queued render-texture commits.
Cleared stale keys after full layouts and tile-view destruction, and cleaned up missing queued tiles defensively.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Added direct skill-menu coverage to the performance harness.
details: Added skillOpen and skillSelect phases to PerfHarnessPhase.
Updated startPerfHarness to open the skill tree, preview another visible skill, then continue through store, pan, zoom, saveStringify, and complete.
Updated docs/PERFORMANCE_HARNESS.md to list the new phases.
